text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One evening. Mejiro Dober, accompanied by 
her Trainer, confronts Air Groove.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober expressed her gratitude to 
Air Groove for guiding her up to this 
point and offered her a single flower—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It was a yellow carnation. A challenge 
from Mejiro Dober to Air Groove, carrying 
her resolve to "surpass you."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove gladly accepted this, then took 
her leave with a promise to wait at the 
Queen Elizabeth II Cup.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Relieved to have boldly declared her 
future before both Air Groove and her 
Trainer, Mejiro Dober flashes a smile...
